families.description: Receives a stereo audio stream from a selected device or host interface.
families.classification_rationale: All implementations expose stereo audio entering the graph; physical transport is implementation detail.

families.description: Sends a stereo audio stream to a selected device or host interface.
families.classification_rationale: All implementations expose stereo audio leaving the graph; physical transport is implementation detail.

families.description: Generates a periodic sine-wave audio signal from pitch and modulation inputs.
families.classification_rationale: The observed object is explicitly an audio oscillator and is normally discovered as a source.

families.description: Generates uniformly distributed broadband noise.
families.classification_rationale: The observation describes a standalone audio noise generator.

families.description: Records an incoming audio signal into a referenced table from a chosen position.
families.classification_rationale: Recording samples into a named table is the object's explicit function.

families.description: Processes buffered stereo audio through granular, pitch, feedback, and spatial modes.
families.classification_rationale: Granular buffer capture and manipulation define the primary drawer role; delay, pitch, feedback, and reverb remain secondary processing functions.

families.description: Generates an attack-decay-sustain-release control contour from a gate.
families.classification_rationale: Both variants generate the same canonical modulation contour; looping is an implementation capability.

families.description: Generates a cyclic sine modulation signal, including an extended slow-range implementation.
families.classification_rationale: Both observations are presented as low-frequency modulation sources rather than audible oscillators.

families.description: Filters one signal into simultaneous low-pass, band-pass, and high-pass responses.
families.classification_rationale: The observed ports and description identify a multimode state-variable filter.

families.description: Combines excitation and a configurable physical-model resonator with extensive modulation.
families.classification_rationale: Resonance is the organizing behavior, while the self-contained exciters also make the object usable as a sound source.

families.description: Computes compression gain from an input level without bundling follower, timing, or VCA stages.
families.classification_rationale: The observation explicitly describes the gain-calculation part of dynamic range compression.

families.description: Applies a compound hard-clipping waveshaper while retaining an inspectable internal graph.
families.classification_rationale: The complete `.axs` graph is a reusable compound whose primary musical function is clipping.

families.description: Creates a fixed-time audio echo with feedback and wet/dry mix.
families.classification_rationale: Audible delayed repeats are the explicit behavior and drawer purpose.

families.description: Provides a reusable tape-style delay as a compound graph.
families.classification_rationale: The complete `.axs` graph is explicitly named and structured as a tape delay.

families.description: Displays signal energy across a bank of twenty-four analysis bands.
families.classification_rationale: The object analyzes and displays frequency-band energy rather than modifying the signal.

families.description: Displays a real fast Fourier transform over 128 input points.
families.classification_rationale: Both observations describe the same spectral display function; one provider-only membership remains unresolved.

families.description: Combines four independently controlled inputs into one output.
families.classification_rationale: Control-rate and audio-rate overloads share one musician-facing mixing function.

families.description: Interpolates between two inputs using a control or signal-rate fade position.
families.classification_rationale: The three type overloads have one stable routing and mixing purpose.

families.description: Converts equal-tempered MIDI note values to frequency with A4 at 440 Hz.
families.classification_rationale: The conversion has explicit note and frequency semantics.

families.description: Maps note values onto a selected musical scale.
families.classification_rationale: Musical scale mapping is the observed object's direct purpose.

families.description: Generates MIDI clock and transport messages from internal timing control.
families.classification_rationale: Clock generation and transport timing are primary; MIDI is the event protocol rather than the category.

families.description: Advances through sixteen parameterized pitch steps from an incoming clock.
families.classification_rationale: Ordered clock-driven step playback is the main behavior; pitch is the sequenced value.

families.description: Adds two control, audio, or integer values using a type-specific implementation.
families.classification_rationale: All three overloaded observations express the same arithmetic operation across signal types.

families.description: Outputs true only when both Boolean inputs are true.
families.classification_rationale: The two-input Boolean operation is explicit and narrowly defined.

families.description: Writes formatted text fields to the Gills OLED through a device-specific service object.
families.classification_rationale: The object is a physical display interface, not a signal-analysis display.

families.description: Reads a selectable analog hardware pin with anti-jitter smoothing and bipolar output.
families.classification_rationale: Physical ADC access and pin selection are the defining behavior.
